cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Social Media Expert position at ICF. With a strong background in digital marketing, content creation, and social media coordination, I am confident in my ability to support your client's social media team in achieving its objectives.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in creating and managing content across various platforms. I write keyword-targeted blog content, manage on-page SEO, and build and maintain WordPress websites. This has taught me how to craft content that resonates with audiences and aligns with organizational goals. I am also proficient in using analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs to monitor performance and derive actionable insights.

My personal project, mirook.com, allowed me to apply social media integration and structured data to enhance online visibility. I implemented JSON-LD schema and optimized for AI search engines, demonstrating my ability to adapt to emerging trends. I am comfortable with graphic design tools like Canva and have experience with audiovisual content, which aligns with the graphic design and audiovisual support requirements of this role.

I am particularly drawn to this position because it combines social media engagement, content creation, and data-driven strategy. I thrive in collaborative environments and am eager to work with internal teams to design and implement measurement strategies. My proactive approach to staying informed about policy and political landscapes, especially within the EU, ensures I can contribute to meaningful conversations.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am fluent in English, with a working knowledge of Dutch. I am eager to bring my skills to ICF and contribute to your client's success. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
